verdict.rationale: Brex's own docs say finance can set spend, documentation and approval rules that Brex AI applies to every transaction, with category-style limits for stipends, travel and procurement. Its review agent auto-approves low-risk expenses and escalates exceptions, and localized policies can be embedded per entity, individual and department. This covers the core of the story, but the evidence is marketing-level only: role-based expense limits are shown only for bill-pay approval routing, and context-dependent rules are not documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of role- and context-conditioned expense policy rules, detail on how auto-approval thresholds are configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can codify our expense policy — limits by category, role, and context — so in-policy expenses auto-approve and only exceptions reach a human

citations.quote: Set rules for how employees can spend, what they need to document, and who needs to approve. Brex AI applies them to every transaction.
Create limits for stipends, travel, procurement, and more. Auto-enforced controls empower employees to spend with confidence.
Your review agent auto-approves low-risk expenses and requests, escalates exceptions, and follows up with anyone out of compliance.
embed localized expense policies to enable spend for entities, individuals, and departments
Tailor multi-level approval flows based on amount, vendor, employee role, and more
